2. Facts relevant for disposal of this Rule, in short, are that the petitioners, as plaintiff, filed Other Suit No. 277 of 2013 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Rangpur for recovery of khas possession of 0.02 acre of land from the defendant demolishing illegal structure erected thereon. 

 6. The defendant transferred his entire share in all ejmal khatians and being titless in the paternal properties in the aforementioned manner shifted to Hazarihat with his family and started living there permanently. After a long time he decided to live with close proximity of his paternal property. For the purpose of erecting house and requested the plaintiff to allow him to erect two chala ghar adjacent to plaintiff’s house and accordingly, the plaintiff accorded permission to defendant to erect chala ghar on 0.02 acre of land which is a part of the plaintiff’s residential house, temporarily. After two years the plaintiff when in his need of the said land requested the defendant to vacate and surrender the land, the defendant refused. Lastly, on 15.11.2013, the plaintiff finally demanded vacant possession of the land but the defendant denied to do so, and hence, the plaintiff filed the present suit for recovery of khas possession of 0.02 acre of land demolishing the structure erected thereon.
